intro.paragraph: Part of the Esri Geospatial Cloud, ArcGIS Insights is analysis software that fuses location analytics with open data science and business intelligence workflows. Answer questions you didn’t know to ask, analyze data completely, and unlock new insights.  Empower analyst of all skill levels, across departments, to directly connect data, perform advanced analytics, and take results into 3rd party systems.

capabilities.title: Powerful analysis made simple
capabilities.desc: Explore data and perform advanced analytics such as spatial, statistical, predictive, and link analysis within an intuitive experience that works the way you do. Revolutionize decision-making with analysis that visually informs the organization of new, previously unexplored insights gained from the perspective of “where”.

blocks.label: Use all relevant data
blocks.title: Analyze data from multiple sources
blocks.desc: Are you using multiple tools to accomplish one thing? Benefit from intuitive, visual analytics that brings location and business data together. Directly connect to data, whether it’s in ArcGIS, relational databases, spreadsheets, or from ArcGIS Living Atlas of the World.

blocks.label: Map visuals without limits
blocks.title: Map any location value and analyze it
blocks.desc: Map any value with projection and location accuracy—addresses, coordinates, lines, or boundaries. Work with an unlimited number of map layers at once. Perform advanced spatial analysis techniques, such as spatial aggregation, find nearest, and drive times, in three clicks or less.

blocks.label: Put data into context
blocks.title: Close data gaps with Esri’s location data
blocks.desc: Ground your data to the real-world by enriching it with variables such as Esri’s demographics, psychographics, and socioeconomic data. Tap into the world's largest collection of ready-to-use geographic content for more than 130 countries. Perform granular analysis that scales down to local geographic levels.

blocks.label: Analytics for all questions
blocks.title: Answer questions you didn’t know you had
blocks.desc: Transform complex datasets into manageable questions. Use exploratory analysis techniques to quickly uncover patterns, trends, correlations, and relationships. Use advanced analytics, such as spatial, statistical, and link analyses, to further analyze data.

blocks.label: Deliver insightful results
blocks.title: Share your findings with confidence
blocks.desc: Create reports that use text, links, images, videos, and branding to clearly communicate your results and show how you reached them. Auto-record analysis workflows that establish repeatable processes and allow you to share your findings with confidence. Publish reports internally or publicly to keep stakeholders informed.

steps.title: Bring in your data
steps.desc: Directly connect to your data. Put your data onto a page by performing a drag-and-drop operation. Visualize data on cards as maps, charts, and tables to unlock endless possibilities for analysis and data exploration.

steps.title: Find answers in your data
steps.desc: Analyze data with ease. Answer questions that guide you to the best tool or dive right into analysis. Quickly aggregate data on a map; reveal hot spots and outliers; make predictions; join data spatially; show relationships between people, places, and events; and more.

steps.title: Show your work
steps.desc: Clearly communicate how you arrived at your results. Share a step-by-step model of your analysis or create an interactive data story that informs internal or external stakeholders.

case.title: Data analysis guides Susquehanna River restoration
case.desc: See how ArcGIS Insights helps organizations make data-driven decisions for environmental restoration, economic development, and community impact.

pills.label: Data analysis guides Susquehanna River restoration
pills.title: Data analysis guides Susquehanna River restoration
pills.desc: Conservation Innovation Center narrows down thousands of parcels, across four counties, to focus on where restoration has an impact on water quality.

pills.label: Location analytics supports wildfire relief effort
pills.title: Location analytics supports wildfire relief effort
pills.desc: Direct Relief uses Facebook Disaster Maps to understand large-scale movement during a disaster and efficiently supply resources to health care agencies and first responders.

pills.label: Insights power the solar and wind energy industry
pills.title: Insights power the solar and wind energy industry
pills.desc: Stakeholders gain visibility into development issues and whether a project is on time and on budget using location analytics.

pills.label: Driving economic growth with location intelligence
pills.title: Driving economic growth with location intelligence
pills.desc: Government officials and business leaders get meaningful and actionable information from ArcGIS instead of sorting through sheets of data.

pills.label: Support for local government initiatives in France
pills.title: Support for local government initiatives in France
pills.desc: When decision-makers need statistics on how the community works, they no longer need to ask. Decision-makers can use Insights to find the answer and act immediately.

pills.label: Insights increases revenue for this water utility
pills.title: Insights increases revenue for this water utility
pills.desc: Opelika Utilities identified hundreds of dead meters and enough water loss to merit a net gain of $25,000 per month in revenue.

deploy.heading: Get started with ArcGIS Insights
deploy.desc: ArcGIS Insights leverages the power of the ArcGIS platform to offer you flexible implementation and deployment options. Select the offering that fits your business needs.

options.title: SaaS deployment
options.desc: Get up and running quickly. Always use the most up-to-date technology anywhere, on any device, anytime.

options.title: On-premises deployment
options.desc: Make ArcGIS Insights accessible across your organization, behind your firewall or on infrastructure that you manage.

options.title: Desktop deployment
options.desc: Complement your SaaS or on-premises deployment with Insights installed natively on your Windows or Mac.

getStarted.leftDesc: Get the latest news on ArcGIS Insights—what’s new and what’s coming.
getStarted.rightDesc: Give feedback and get ideas from a community of users and experts.
